title: the Marlowe Estate Rising Again
author: Silas Yarrow
blurb: Marguerite Eriksen, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
